window.rule: first run of >=28 (else 21, 14) consecutive days starting on a Monday in Nov-Feb with >=90% data coverage over each full day (and the following day)

standard.sentence: First activity usually 10:14 ± 75 min on weekdays. Kettle asks if nothing by 13:14.

cold.sentence: First activity usually 10:14 ± 75 min on weekdays. Kettle asks if nothing by 12:14.

standard.sentence: First activity usually 10:15 ± 86 min on weekdays. Kettle asks if nothing by 13:15.

cold.sentence: First activity usually 10:15 ± 86 min on weekdays. Kettle asks if nothing by 12:15.

notes: events = cycles the whole-home (Aggregate) detector marked human (v1); kettle_iam_uses = the shipped detector on the kettle IAM (v0, a smart plug equivalent)
min = minutes after local midnight; a Kettle day starts at 04:00
*_rolling_deadline/checkin: model trained only on earlier days (all available history), standard policy

provenance.citation: Murray, D., Stankovic, L. & Stankovic, V. (2017). An electrical load measurements dataset of United Kingdom households from a two-year longitudinal study. Scientific Data 4, 160122. doi:10.1038/sdata.2016.122
provenance.time_zone: Europe/London (REFIT Unix column is local wall-clock time; see docs/refit-evaluation.md)
